files_changed.summary: Added RunID (pipeline_runs.id), following the existing strong-ID-type convention rather than defining an ID type locally in pipeline/.
RunStatus (mirrors run_status enum), Mode (mirrors session_mode enum), ErrInvalidTransition sentinel, Run struct, and NewRun/Start/Advance/Fail/Cancel — all pure, no I/O, caller-supplied 'now'.

Table-driven tests: Start (pending ok, all other statuses rejected), Advance (all 6 forward steps + auto-done on the last stage, rejected when not running), Fail/Cancel (pending+running ok, all 3 terminal statuses rejected).

decisions: Advance() auto-completes the run (Status -> done, FinishedAt set) when called while CurrentStage is already the last stage in Order, instead of adding a 5th Complete/Finish method — confirmed with user before coding.
Fail()/Cancel() take no reason/error argument, matching pipeline_runs having no such column — confirmed with user before coding.
Reused pipeline.Order/indexOf from task 006 for next-stage lookup instead of re-deriving stage sequence, keeping Order the single order source across both tasks.
